mapper.sql:
select w.wrong_id, w.user_name, w.question_id, w.subject_id, s.subject_name,
w.chapter_id, w.chapter_text, w.question_type, q.content,
w.wrong_count, w.mastered, w.last_wrong_time, w.create_time,
(
select r.picked_answer
from edu_qb_practice_record r
where r.user_name = w.user_name
and r.question_id = w.question_id
and r.correct_flag = '0'
order by r.create_time desc, r.record_id desc
limit 1
) as last_wrong_answer
from edu_qb_wrong_book w
left join edu_qb_question q on q.question_id = w.question_id and q.del_flag = '0'
left join edu_subject s on s.subject_id = w.subject_id
mapper.select:
select
count(*) filter (where mastered = '0')::int as active_count,
count(*) filter (where mastered = '1')::int as mastered_count,
coalesce(sum(wrong_count) filter (where mastered = '0'), 0)::int as total_wrong_attempts
from edu_qb_wrong_book
where user_name = #{userName}
and subject_id = #{subjectId}
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_qb_wrong_book (
user_name, question_id, subject_id, chapter_id, chapter_text, question_type,
wrong_count, last_wrong_time, mastered, create_time
) values (
#{userName}, #{questionId}, #{subjectId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterText}, #{questionType},
#{wrongCount}, now(), '0', now()
)

insert into edu_qb_wrong_book (
user_name, question_id, subject_id, chapter_id, chapter_text, question_type,
wrong_count, last_wrong_time, mastered, create_time
) values (
#{userName}, #{questionId}, #{subjectId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterText}, #{questionType},
1, now(), '0', now()
)
on conflict (user_name, question_id) do update set
subject_id = excluded.subject_id,
chapter_id = excluded.chapter_id,
chapter_text = excluded.chapter_text,
question_type = excluded.question_type,
wrong_count = edu_qb_wrong_book.wrong_count + 1,
last_wrong_time = now(),
mastered = '0',
update_time = now()
mapper.delete:
delete from edu_qb_wrong_book
where wrong_id = #{wrongId} and user_name = #{userName}
